rule.CARRIES: resolvable, add_share >= 0.5, drop_share >= 0.5, both placebos beaten (positive mean difference), the permuted-placebo difference has one-sided p < 0.10, and the add arm beats B1 in at least 6 of 8 folds
rule.NOT_CARRYING: otherwise (including groups whose contribution is too small to resolve; low power is a possible reason and is not distinguished from absence)
rule.SHARES: resolvable and not CARRIES, with add_share >= 0.25 or drop_share >= 0.25
rule.gain: the EXP-012 T1 gain, IC(B5) - IC(B1); if it is not positive nothing is attributed and every group is labelled NO_GAIN
rule.note: descriptive labels; the groups overlap through collinearity, so shares need not sum to one; no confirmatory claim is made
rule.resolvable: the add contrast (add arm - B1) is positive with one-sided Newey-West p < 0.10; without it nothing is claimed for the group, because a share of a small, noisy gain is not interpretable
